steps.name: Snapshot source fixture SHA-256 values
steps.artifact_contract: Record the SHA-256 values for the three source fixtures before invoking check-spec-health.
steps.verifier_gate: The final integrity step must reproduce the exact hash listing.

steps.name: Check a well-specified atom
steps.command: MUMEI_BIN={mumei_bin} {mumei_agent_python} -m agent check-spec-health {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/healthy.mm --mumei-repo {mumei_repo} --output {output_dir}/healthy.json > {output_dir}/healthy.stdout 2> {output_dir}/healthy.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/healthy.json; cat {output_dir}/healthy.stdout; cat {output_dir}/healthy.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); atom=sys.argv[2]; assert isinstance(r.get("contradictions"),list), r; assert isinstance(r.get("vacuous"),list), r; assert not any(isinstance(e,dict) and e.get("atom")==atom for e in r["contradictions"]), r; assert not any(isinstance(e,dict) and e.get("atom")==atom for e in r["vacuous"]), r; print("healthy_spec absent from contradiction/vacuity diagnostics")' {output_dir}/healthy.json healthy_spec
steps.artifact_contract: The tested report keys contain no contradictions or vacuous entry for healthy_spec.
steps.verifier_gate: Pass only when healthy_spec has no matching atom in contradictions or vacuous.

steps.name: Check contradictory requires
steps.command: MUMEI_BIN={mumei_bin} {mumei_agent_python} -m agent check-spec-health {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/contradictory.mm --mumei-repo {mumei_repo} --output {output_dir}/contradictory.json > {output_dir}/contradictory.stdout 2> {output_dir}/contradictory.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/contradictory.json; cat {output_dir}/contradictory.stdout; cat {output_dir}/contradictory.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert isinstance(r.get("contradictions"),list), r; assert any(isinstance(e,dict) and e.get("atom")=="contradictory_requires" for e in r["contradictions"]), r; print("contradictory_requires reported under contradictions")' {output_dir}/contradictory.json
steps.artifact_contract: The tested contradictions list includes the target atom contradictory_requires.
steps.verifier_gate: Pass only when contradictory_requires appears under contradictions.

steps.name: Check vacuity atom attribution
steps.command: MUMEI_BIN={mumei_bin} {mumei_agent_python} -m agent check-spec-health {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/weak_spec.mm --mumei-repo {mumei_repo} --output {output_dir}/vacuity.json > {output_dir}/vacuity.stdout 2> {output_dir}/vacuity.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/vacuity.json; cat {output_dir}/vacuity.stdout; cat {output_dir}/vacuity.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); entries=r.get("vacuous"); assert isinstance(entries,list) and len(entries)==1, r; entry=entries[0]; assert entry.get("atom")=="weak_spec", r; message=entry.get("message"); assert isinstance(message,str) and "vacuous" in message.lower(), r; print("exactly one vacuity diagnostic attributed to weak_spec")' {output_dir}/vacuity.json
expected_patterns: exactly one vacuity diagnostic attributed to weak_spec
steps.artifact_contract: The tested vacuous list has exactly one entry whose atom is weak_spec and whose message contains vacuous case-insensitively.
steps.verifier_gate: An unknown or other atom, a missing message, or any vacuous-entry count other than one fails the step.

steps.name: Check source fixture integrity
steps.command: before=$(cat {output_dir}/input_hashes.before); after=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/healthy.mm {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/contradictory.mm {root_dir}/scenarios/check_spec_health/src/weak_spec.mm); test "$before" = "$after" && echo 'source fixture SHA-256 values unchanged'
steps.artifact_contract: The source fixture SHA-256 listing is identical before and after all route calls.
steps.verifier_gate: All declared .mm fixture bytes remain unchanged.
